profiles.notes: The simplest real profile: Windows Notepad. `class` and `process` must match exactly, `title` is a regex.

Cisco Packet Tracer 8.x is a Qt app: the whole widget tree is on UIA, and the IOS console lives in the device window (third tab). Read it with `readtext`, and fall back to `readtext {ocr:true}` when the terminal gives no text at all.
Browser dashboards: match on the title instead of the process, because every tab shares the browser's pid.
